analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – addresses a genuine consumer pain point (misleading animal welfare claims) and offers a tangible solution (a barcode scanner and alternative suggestions). The ‘take action’ component adds a layer.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Claims about shopper survey statistics and external reporting are promising but lack specific data.
